evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0001 shows a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype relative to the rest of the partition. The dominant up-enriched programs are oxidative phosphorylation and reactive oxygen species handling, together with a broad immune/inflammatory axis (interferon gamma and alpha responses, allograft rejection, complement, IL6/JAK/STAT3, inflammatory response) and a proliferative/metabolic axis (DNA repair, MYC targets V1/V2, E2F targets, G2M checkpoint, MTORC1 signaling, glycolysis). Several developmental/signaling programs are down-enriched (UV response DN, TGF-beta, WNT beta-catenin, Hedgehog). The multiplicity-adjusted FDR q values are small for the leading pathways, and the leading-edge gene sets are large and internally consistent, indicating a multi-program rather than a single isolated pathway signal. This characterizes biological identity; it does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
